name: shared-helper-catalog
goal: List only exported codebase-wide helpers, with real signatures from the selected commit.

evidence: Functions lists exported standalone helpers in shared utility modules at the selected commit. Types, schemas, class methods, private and feature-local functions are excluded; unused exported helpers remain eligible.

Existing catalog and viewport fixtures contained only one callable module. Extend those fixtures with non-callable and unknown metadata, multiple exports, no callers, and exact-commit history projection assertions.
